name: BLE iBeacon (kitsune)
description: A kitsune fox advertising an iBeacon frame: UUID, major, minor, device name, spoofed address, advertising interval and power; always on, or advertising bursts between deep sleeps. Configuration is compiled into the firmware from a conference header; this page prepares, checks and exports that header (docs/kitsune-integration-plan.md). kitsune belongs to its authors: https://github.com/rfhs/kitsune
